'''Audio transmitters''' were a type of [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] that could send and receive audio signals. An individual using an implanted [[At-cyb husher mike]] needed a partner using an audio transmitter or [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to send and receive messages. <ref name="EGWT" />
